title: 扩展 TypeScript 类型定义（SkillLayer, SkillPackageMeta, etc.）
description: 在 src/types/skill.ts 中新增 SkillLayer, SkillPackageMeta, SkillCommand, SkillDependencies, SkillTrust, SkillExperimental 等类型，与 skill.schema.json 对齐。
action: 在 src/types/skill.ts 中新增 SkillLayer, SkillCommand, SkillDependencies, SkillTrust, SkillAction, SkillExperimental, SkillAgent, SkillHook, SkillPackageMeta 接口，并在 src/types/index.ts 中导出新类型

criteria: src/types/skill.ts 包含 SkillLayer 接口（id, file, trigger, description?, content?）
src/types/skill.ts 包含 SkillPackageMeta 接口（extends SkillMeta, 含 schema_version, runtime?, layers, commands?, dependencies?, _trust?, experimental?）
src/types/skill.ts 包含 SkillCommand 接口（name, file, description?, args?）
src/types/skill.ts 包含 SkillDependencies 接口（skills?, runtime?, tools?）
src/types/skill.ts 包含 SkillTrust 接口（source, verified, risk）
src/types/skill.ts 包含 SkillExperimental 接口（scripts?, hooks?, agents?, interaction?）
src/types/index.ts 导出所有新增类型
tsc 编译通过无类型错误
convergence.definition_of_done: 所有新增 TypeScript 类型定义完成，与 schema 对齐，tsc 编译通过

files.change: 在文件末尾追加 SkillLayer, SkillCommand, SkillDependencies, SkillTrust, SkillAction, SkillExperimental, SkillAgent, SkillHook, SkillPackageMeta 接口定义
在 skill 导出行追加新增类型：SkillLayer, SkillPackageMeta, SkillCommand, SkillDependencies, SkillTrust, SkillExperimental

implementation: 在 src/types/skill.ts 末尾追加以下接口：
SkillLayer: { id: string; file: string; trigger: string; description?: string; content?: string }
SkillCommand: { name: string; file: string; description?: string; args?: Record<string, { type: string; required?: boolean; description?: string }> }
SkillDependencies: { skills?: string[]; runtime?: string[]; tools?: string[] }
SkillAction: { id: string; label: string; intent: string }
SkillExperimental: { scripts?: Record<string, { file: string; sandbox: string }>; hooks?: SkillHook[]; agents?: SkillAgent[]; interaction?: { actions?: SkillAction[] } }
SkillAgent: { name: string; file: string; description?: string; model?: string; tools?: string[] }
SkillHook: { name: string; file: string; event: 'pre-task' | 'post-task' | 'pre-invoke' | 'post-invoke' }

SkillPackageMeta: extends SkillMeta + { schema_version: string; runtime?: { min_version?: string; engine?: string[]; platform?: string[] }; layers: SkillLayer[]; commands?: SkillCommand[]; dependencies?: SkillDependencies; _trust?: SkillTrust; experimental?: SkillExperimental; author?: string; license?: string; tags?: string[] }
在 src/types/index.ts 的 skill 导出行追加新增类型名
运行 npx tsc --noEmit 验证编译通过

success_metrics: 所有新增接口定义完整

rationale.chosen_approach: 在现有 skill.ts 文件中追加新类型，而非创建新文件，保持类型定义集中
decision_factors: 现有 SkillMeta 定义在 context.ts，但 skill 相关类型集中在 skill.ts
新增类型与 skill.json schema 一一对应，便于后续自动校验
SkillPackageMeta extends SkillMeta 保持向后兼容

risks.risk: SkillPackageMeta 与 SkillMeta 字段冲突
risks.mitigation: 使用 extends 继承，不重复定义已有字段

affected_requirements: Module 007 Phase 1 Must Have: TypeScript 类型定义
